profile.headline: R&D Software Developer at Keysight Technologies
profile.summary:
Computer engineer with experience with C, Linux device drivers, Verilog, Python, and C#. Particularly interested in FPGA design, hardware abstraction, and Linux kernel development.

Specialties: Verilog, C, Python, System integration

positions.title: R&D Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for development and maintenance of hardware abstraction layer for X-series spectrum analysers, including:

-Adding support for new hardware (USB hardware in particular)
-Development of new features (including, to some extent, FPGA design)
